name: ... and Bugs
summary: Morgan Stern in Theramore is working on a recipe that could become the next food craze in Stormwind. With the Mudrock tongues already in hand, the next part of the dish calls for the shelled legs of a giant crab, and only pristine, unscarred ones will do.

sections.title: Legs Without a Scratch
sections.body: Morgan Stern wants the shell of the crab leg to be a key part of how the dish looks, so every leg has to be pristine and unscarred. An adult crab might carry only one or two such legs, and the research calls for a lot of them. The Muckshells of Dustwallow Marsh will not do. Only the crabs of the faraway Swamp of Sorrows will suit, so a journey lies ahead.

faq.answer: Morgan Stern is working in Theramore on a new recipe that might become the next food craze in Stormwind.

faq.q: Where do the crab legs come from?
faq.answer: Not from Dustwallow Marsh, where the Muckshells are no good for the dish. Morgan Stern points to the Swamp of Sorrows, far away, for crabs that will do.

faq.q: Why do the crab legs need to be pristine?
faq.answer: The shell is a key part of how the dish is presented, so Morgan Stern wants legs with no scars on them.
It follows Mudrock Soup and Bugs, the first part of the work you did for Morgan Stern's new recipe.
